# tu 1.1.5 — a window, not a takeover

## What's new since `v1.1.4`

- **60 % popup.** Inside tmux, `tu` now opens as a `display-popup`
  covering 60 % of the client, centred, so the panes underneath stay
  visible and keep updating while you pick a session. Outside tmux it
  draws a centred 60 % window on a blank screen. `--size PCT` /
  `TU_SIZE` set the size; `--size 100` restores full screen.
- **tmux config, managed properly.** tu's settings now live in a file
  it owns, `~/.config/tu/tmux.conf`, and `~/.tmux.conf` gets exactly
  one `source-file` line. The managed file is regenerated and
  re-applied live whenever tu's template changes, so improvements
  reach existing installs; your own settings below the include line
  always win. Sourcing it repeatedly no longer duplicates the status-bar
  button.
  - Upgrading from 1.1.x: on first launch tu offers once to replace
    its old `# Added by tu … # End of tu` block with the single line.
    Lines you wrote before or after the block are kept in place.
- **Attach-first layout.** Buttons are Attach · New · Rename · Delete ·
  Detach, with Attach focused by default; ↑/↓ then Enter attaches.
  Cancel became an `x` close chip in the top-right corner (Esc still
  closes). The row adapts to the width: `Attach (a)` at 74+ cells,
  `Attach` at 56+, bordered keys at 32+, bare keys below.
- **Long session names** take the available width and end in `…`
  instead of pushing the window count off screen; the Rename field
  grows with the window.
- The "inside / outside tmux" title text and the idle status line are
  gone.

## Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hungryZoo/tu/main/install.sh | sh
```

Already on 1.1.3 or 1.1.4? Press **u** in `tu`.
